==Information==
Adriano 'Escher' Lorenzini is an Italian Quake 1 and QuakeWorld map maker. He created the well known FFA classics Ultra Violence ([[Ultrav]]) and De Bello Quakero (debello), as well as the old-school australian favourite Messy Base ([[Messy]]).

A list of maps he has created can be found here:
https://www.quakewiki.net/archives/peek/authors/escher.html
